title: MAI HAƁAKA MANHAJOJIN 3D/XR
meta: Salary aligned with the market + typical French benefits (Health Insurance, 50% Transportation card)
html:
Nauyin Aiki

Wanda aka zaɓa zai ɗauki nauyin waɗannan ayyuka:

  • Tsarawa da haɓaka manhajojin 3D da XR masu aiki nan take, tare da muhimman sassansu
  • Ginawa da inganta manhajojin XR na mu’amala don visionOS da dandamalin da suka dace da ma’aunin OpenXR
  • Aiwatarwa da kula da jerin matakan zana hotuna ƙarƙashin tsauraran sharuɗɗan inganci da jinkirin amsawa
  • Aiki da bin diddigin matsayi a sarari, taswirar muhalli, bin motsin hannu, da na’urorin ji da ke cikin kayan aiki
  • Inganta adadin hotuna a kowace daƙiƙa, amfani da ƙwaƙwalwa, da cin wutar lantarki a na’urorin XR
  • Haɗa injunan 3D, SDK na asali, da API na musamman na kowane dandamali
  • Gano da gyara matsaloli masu sarƙaƙiya da suka shafi zana hotuna, daidaita lokaci, da daidaituwar matsayi a sarari
  • Haɗa kai da masu zane, ƙungiyoyin kayayyaki, da injiniyoyin tsarin
  • Shiga cikin yanke shawarwari kan tsarin gine-ginen manhaja da dabarun fasahar XR na dogon lokaci
  • Samar da takardun bayanin fasaha masu inganci da kuma duba lambobin shirye-shirye a matakin babban ƙwararre

Ƙwarewar Fasaha da Ake Buƙata

  • Ƙwaƙƙwaran tushe a lissafin 3D na nan take (aljabarar layi, sauye-sauyen matsayi, lissafin jefa hoto)
  • Gogewa mai ƙarfi wajen haɓaka manhajojin haƙiƙanin gaskiya da aka faɗaɗa / XR
  • Zurfin sanin visionOS da salon sarrafa bayanai a sarari da take bi
  • Gogewa a aikace da OpenXR (haɗawa da tsarin aiki, ƙarin fasali, da samar da tsari ɗaya ga na’urori daban-daban)
  • Zurfin fahimtar ginshiƙan zana hotuna (zagayen zane, ƙananan shirye-shiryen launi na GPU, daidaita aiki tsakanin GPU da CPU)
  • Gogewar aiki ƙarƙashin sharuɗɗan nan take (kasafin lokacin kowane hoto, jinkirin amsawa, tazarar lokaci tsakanin motsi da bayyanar hoto)
  • Harsunan shirye-shirye: C++ / Swift / Objective-C (don visionOS da dandamalin Apple) / C# (Unity ko kayan aikin matakin inji) / Rust (don sassan da inganci ke da matuƙar muhimmanci ko na matakin inji — babban ƙari ne)
  • Tsare-tsaren aiki: visionOS SDK, OpenXR, Unity, Unreal Engine, ko injunan cikin gida na musamman, Metal, Vulkan, ko DirectX, tsare-tsaren haƙiƙanin gaskiya da aka faɗaɗa (ARKit ko makamantansu na bin diddigin matsayi a sarari)

Wanda Muke Nema

  • Shekaru 5 zuwa 10 na gogewar aiki a fannin haɓaka manhajoji, tare da mai da hankali sosai kan shirye-shiryen tsarin 3D/XR
  • Tabbataccen tarihin aiki kan tsarukan fasaha masu sarƙaƙiya da muhimmanci
  • Ƙwaƙƙwaran tunani a fannin 3D/XR da iya fahimtar manyan rumbunan lambobin shirye-shirye da ke akwai
  • Matuƙar tsantseni, cin gashin kai, da kula da ƙananan bayanai, da tsananin sha’awar warware matsalolin fasaha masu wuyar gaske
  • Ƙwarewar da za ta ƙara maka daraja: gogewa a haƙiƙanin gaskiya mai gauraye ko tsara mu’amalar mai amfani a sarari
  • Ƙwarewar da za ta ƙara maka daraja: gudummawa ga ayyukan buɗaɗɗen tushe da suka shafi 3D, XR, ko zane-zanen kwamfuta

Matakan Tattaunawar Ɗaukar Aiki

  1. Kiran Tantancewa na Minti 15 — Taƙaitacciyar hira kan ƙwarin gwiwarka da dacewarka, tare da amsa tambayoyinka da ba na fasaha ba.
  2. Tattaunawar Fasaha da Kayayyaki ta Awa 1, Sau Biyu — Zurfafa duba yadda kake tunkarar warware matsaloli, tare da CTO ɗinmu da/ko babban mai tsara mafitarmu.
  3. Gaisawa da Ƙungiya — Zama na sakin jiki domin tabbatar da cewa ka dace da al’adar aikinmu.

Abin da Muke Bayarwa

  • Aiki kan fasahohin XR da na sarrafa bayanai a sarari mafi zamani
  • Cikakken iko kan tsarukan nan take masu ƙalubalen fasaha
  • Ayyuka masu zurfin fasaha da ke ƙalubalantar tunani
  • Yanayin aiki da ke daraja ƙwarewar injiniya ta gaske kuma ya mai da hankali kan fasaha (babu tarukan banza ko rubuce-rubucen rahotanni marasa amfani)
  • Cikakken ’yancin yanke shawarwarin fasaha
